# Controls

The Collections group holds the controls that take data. A view (`ListView`, `TileView`, `TreeView`, `TableView`) is given `.items` and an `.item` template and adds selection and scrolling, `ForEach` turns a collection into plain children, and the [item layouts](item-layouts.md) arrange them. Controls that arrange children you write yourself are under [Layout](../layout/index.md).

## Basic Input

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [Button](button.md) | A push button, clicked by mouse (press and release inside), Enter/Space while focused, or UI Automation's Invoke. |
| [CheckBox](check-box.md) | A box that is checked, unchecked or indeterminate, with an optional label to its right. |
| [ColorPicker](color-picker.md) | A hue/saturation/value/alpha color editor with channel, alpha and hex text entry and a preview swatch. |
| [ComboBox](combo-box.md) | A combo box: a closed box showing one item of a list of strings, and a chevron that opens the list as a popup floating above the rest of the tree, so opening it never reflows the layout. |
| [DropdownButton](dropdown-button.md) | A Button with a trailing chevron that says a click opens a menu or flyout. |
| [RadioButton](radio-button.md) | A round option button with a label, one of a set of mutually exclusive choices. |
| [RadioButtons](radio-buttons.md) | A headed group of mutually exclusive string options, as one element. |
| [Rating](rating.md) | A row of stars the user rates with a click, a drag or the keyboard. |
| [Slider](slider.md) | A thumb dragged along a track to pick a value in [min(), max()]. |
| [SplitButton](split-button.md) | A button with a second, chevron part that opens a flyout. |
| [ToggleButton](toggle-button.md) | A Button that stays pressed, with a nullable checked state. |
| [ToggleSwitch](toggle-switch.md) | A boolean on/off switch: a pill-shaped track with a sliding thumb, an optional header above it and a label beside it that follows the state. |

## Text

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [AutoSuggestBox](auto-suggest-box.md) | A text box with a floating list of suggestions the app supplies as the user types, for search boxes and type-ahead pickers. |
| [NumberBox](number-box.md) | A text box for a number, validated and formatted when committed. |
| [PasswordBox](password-box.md) | A single-line field that masks what is typed into it. |
| [RichEditBox](rich-edit-box.md) | An editable, formatted document that looks like a TextBox. |
| [RichText](rich-text.md) | Read-only paragraphs of formatted inlines, wrapping by default, selectable, with links and highlighters. |
| [Text](text.md) | A non-interactive run of text, the label of every form. |
| [TextBox](text-box.md) | Single- or multi-line editable text. |

## Collections

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [ForEach](for-each.md) | A repeater: a collection laid out by an attachable Layout that realizes only the items in view. |
| [Item Layouts](item-layouts.md) | The base of every attachable layout. |
| [ListView](list-view.md) | A vertical, virtualized, selectable list of templated items. |
| [ListViewBase](list-view-base.md) | The shared base of ListView and TileView: a scrolling, virtualized, selectable collection of templated items. |
| [TableView](table-view.md) | A table: a header strip over virtualized rows, with sorting, resizable columns, frozen leading and trailing columns, four selection modes, cell templates, cell editing and collapsible groups. |
| [TileView](tile-view.md) | Templated items in wrapping rows of equal cells, virtualized and selectable. |
| [TreeView](tree-view.md) | A hierarchy of expandable rows, with single or multiple (check box) selection, templated rows, and rearranging by drag and drop. |
| [VirtualList](virtual-list.md) | A list that scrolls itself and creates Elements only for the rows in view. |

## Date and Time

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [CalendarDatePicker](calendar-date-picker.md) | A field that shows a date and opens a CalendarView under itself to pick one. |
| [CalendarView](calendar-view.md) | A month calendar: the days of one month in a grid of weeks, with the month's name above them and buttons to page through months. |
| [DatePicker](date-picker.md) | A field that shows a date in its parts (day, month and year, in the order the locale writes them) and opens a flyout of three spinning columns to pick one. |
| [TimePicker](time-picker.md) | A field that shows a time of day in its parts (hour, minute and, on a 12-hour clock, AM or PM) and opens a flyout of spinning columns to pick one. |

## Navigation

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [Breadcrumb](breadcrumb.md) | A navigation trail (Home > Folder > File) of plain text items, root first. |
| [Carousel](carousel.md) | Shows one item at a time, filling the whole view, and flips between them with previous/next buttons, the mouse wheel or the keyboard. |
| [NavigationFrame](navigation-frame.md) | A page host with a back and forward stack: shows one page at a time, built by a PageFactory on each navigation, and animates between pages with a NavigationTransition. |
| [NavigationShell](navigation-shell.md) | A navigation view: a pane of navigation items (left, compact, minimal or a top bar) beside a content area that shows the selected item's page. |
| [Pager](pager.md) | A pager: First / Previous buttons, a page selector ("Page [n] of N" in a NumberBox or drop-down, or a row of page buttons), and Next / Last buttons. |
| [PipsPager](pips-pager.md) | A strip of small dots, one per page, for paging through a large item set such as a `Carousel`'s pictures. |
| [Sections](sections.md) | A row of large text headers over the selected item's content. |
| [SelectorBar](selector-bar.md) | A row of text segments, each with an optional icon. |
| [Tabs](tabs.md) | A strip of tabs over the selected tab's content. |

## Menus and Toolbars

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [AppBarButton](app-bar-button.md) | A command-bar button: an icon over a small label that changes shape with where it sits. |
| [CommandBar](command-bar.md) | A toolbar of app-bar buttons with an overflow menu behind a More ("...") button. |
| [CommandBarFlyout](command-bar-flyout.md) | The mini-toolbar of an in-app object: a small row of icon-only commands in a flyout, with a menu of more commands under it behind a "More" button. |
| [ContextMenu](context-menu.md) | A child with a context menu. |
| [MenuBar](menu-bar.md) | A horizontal menu bar: a row of headers, each dropping down a cascading MenuFlyout-style menu that floats in the overlay layer under the header's left edge. |
| [MenuFlyout](menu-flyout.md) | A list of commands in a popup: hung from an anchor element (a click on a Button anchor toggles it) or opened at a point with show_at() for a context menu. |

## Dialogs and Flyouts

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [Dialog](dialog.md) | A modal dialog over the whole window, with a title, arbitrary content and up to three buttons. |
| [Flyout](flyout.md) | Arbitrary content floating in a popup next to an owned anchor. |
| [Popup](popup.md) | Floats one child above the tree, at an offset from where the Popup sits. |
| [TeachingTip](teaching-tip.md) | A card that points at a control (or sits against the window) to teach something about it. |
| [ToolTip](tool-tip.md) | Hover text for an element, opened after the pointer rests on the anchor and closed when the pointer leaves or clicks. |

## Status and Info

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [InfoBadge](info-badge.md) | A small non-interactive badge showing a number, an icon or a plain dot, typically over a navigation item or a button to flag new or pending items. |
| [InfoBar](info-bar.md) | An inline, closable banner that shows an app-wide status message with a severity color and icon. |
| [ProgressBar](progress-bar.md) | A thin horizontal bar showing determinate progress, or an endless sweep while the duration is unknown. |
| [ProgressRing](progress-ring.md) | Circular progress, by default an indeterminate spinner. |

## Media and Icons

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [AnimatedIcon](animated-icon.md) | An icon that animates between named visual states by playing segments of an AnimatedIconSource. |
| [AnimatedVisualPlayer](animated-visual-player.md) | Plays a caller-supplied AnimatedVisualSource by advancing its progress over time and drawing each frame with the source's render_frame(). |
| [Icon](icon.md) | A non-interactive icon: a symbol, a font glyph, a path, a bitmap or a picture. |

| [InkCanvas](ink-canvas.md) | A surface the user draws ink on with the pointer. |
| [InkToolbar](ink-toolbar.md) | A row of ink tools bound to a ui::InkCanvasControl. |
| [PersonPicture](person-picture.md) | A circular avatar showing a photo, initials or a placeholder glyph, with an optional badge. |
| [Shapes](shapes.md) | The base of the shapes. |

## Windowing and Hosting

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [DragArea](drag-area.md) | A wrapper whose content the window can be dragged by. |
| [Match](content-host.md) | A node that owns exactly one child and can replace it at runtime. |
| [NativeControl](native-control.md) | An Element that hosts a real platform child window (an HWND on Windows) of any window class, the escape hatch for OS controls the framework does not draw itself. |
| [TitleBar](title-bar.md) | A chrome row with an icon, title and subtitle, optional back and pane-toggle (hamburger) buttons, and three content slots (left header, content, right header). |
